name: Raster probe
description: Window check fixture: a view whose image region shows the frames of the fake persistent sidecar rasterprobe, which reports the view, its session, its frames and its input as statuses.

status.name: rasterprobe.view
status.description: The view: the size and position of the image region in CSS pixels, its size in device pixels, the device pixel ratio and the text size factor of the surface.

status.name: rasterprobe.session
status.description: The session of the surface as the sidecar reported it (session, created, child process, service pid, version and folder, mode image or headless, color, rows, text size factor), whether the sidecar is connected, and the last failure or refused request.

status.name: rasterprobe.frame
status.description: The last frame that the sidecar sent: its identity (generation, raster, sequence), its raster in device pixels and scale, its grid (rows, columns and cell size), the row bands it paints, its color, the color of its identity marker and the time in microseconds that painting it took (draw_us); null before the first frame.

status.name: rasterprobe.input
status.description: The image region input: whether it holds focus, its last preedit, the number of input transactions and the actions and errors of the last one; log holds in order the last 256 transactions {sequence, cids, actions, preedit, errors, received}, where received is the body that the sidecar echoed for it (null until it arrives); pointer holds the last 64 pointerdown and pointerup events of the region {type, button, trusted}. A primary press on the region gives it the keyboard focus.

commands.name: rasterprobe.rows
commands.description: Asks the sidecar to paint count row bands in the next frames.

commands.name: rasterprobe.color
commands.description: Asks the sidecar to paint the frames in the color #rrggbb.

commands.name: rasterprobe.state
commands.description: Asks the sidecar for the state of the session, which updates rasterprobe.session.

commands.name: rasterprobe.focus
commands.description: Gives the image region the keyboard focus.

commands.name: rasterprobe.input.clear
commands.description: Empties the log and the pointer list of rasterprobe.input; the count of transactions continues.

commands.name: rasterprobe.close
commands.description: Closes the session of the surface and its child process.

commands.name: rasterprobe.kill
commands.description: Asks the sidecar service to end at once with SIGKILL, as a crash of the service would.

element.name: rasterprobe.raster
element.description: The element of the image region, which the frames of the sidecar fill.
